title: In range
prompt: The robot's sensor only trusts readings inside a range. in_range says whether n is between low and high, with both ends counting.
starter:
func in_range(n, low, high):
	return false
hints: Two conditions joined with and: n against low, and n against high.

docs.what: Comparisons. Each gives true or false.

docs.name: and  or  not
docs.what: and is true when both sides are; or when at least one is; not flips true and false.

solution:
func in_range(n, low, high):
	return low <= n and n <= high
